2610.09498.title: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
2610.09498.paper_summary: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.
2610.09498.paper_summary_zh: 臨床視覺模型通常作為凍結的黑箱部署，無法在推理時訪問內部、重新訓練或獲取真實標籤。我們介紹了 \textbf{SpatialUQ}，這是一種僅使用輸出概率的事後不確定性方法。它測量全局預測與六次確定性前向傳遞中五個固定空間裁剪的均值之間的詹森-香農散度。前提很簡單，值得信賴的預測在空間上是一致的。在 NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$) 上，我們的多裁剪不確定性分數 (MUS) 達到 $0.784$ 的失敗檢測 AUC，而 MC-Dropout 則為 $0.664$ ($p{<}10^{-6}$)，計算量僅為其五分之一，並且原生校準 ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ 對比 $\ell_1$ 的 $0.127$)，在 AUC 超過 0.78 的方法中，校準效果最佳。將 MUS 與熵、置信度和 $\ell_1$ 進行監督融合可達到 $0.832$，超過五成員集成 ($0.813$)。MUS 隨著模型質量的提高而擴展，在 BiomedCLIP 中達到 $0.899$ ($ρ= 0.846$)，而這種關係在分佈內仍然有意義 ($ρ= 0.523$)，但在嚴重的分佈轉移下則失效 (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$)。MUS 非常適合擴散發現，但對於小型焦點病變如結節則不太可靠。代碼和實驗材料可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ 上公開獲取。
